privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This explains what AltCare collects, why, and the choices you have. It applies to this website and the AltCare clinic software.
privacy.s1Body: Account details (name, email, clinic details, role). The records a clinic enters into the software — patients, appointments, prescriptions and payments. Basic technical data such as IP address and device type, used for security and to prevent abuse.
privacy.s2Body: Each clinic decides what it records about its patients and is responsible for it. AltCare stores that information on the clinic's behalf and does not use it for advertising.
privacy.s3Body: Each clinic's records are kept separate from every other clinic's. Passwords are stored hashed, integration credentials are encrypted, and connections use HTTPS.
privacy.s4Body: We use a sign-in cookie that is needed for the service to work, and remember your language and light/dark choice on your device. We do not use advertising cookies. If we measure visits, we use privacy-friendly statistics that do not follow you across sites.
privacy.s5Body: You can ask to see, correct or delete your account information. Patients should ask their clinic about records the clinic holds. Use the contact details below.
privacy.s6Body: If you use "request a call back" on a practitioner's profile, we collect your name, phone number and, if you choose to add them, a preferred time and a message. This goes to that practitioner's clinic, by email and in their AltCare dashboard, so they can call you. AltCare uses it only to pass on and count your request. We do not sell it or use it for advertising. The clinic keeps it until it closes the request. How long we keep it after that is still to be confirmed.
privacy.s7Body: If this policy changes materially we will update the date above and, where appropriate, tell account holders.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By creating an account or using AltCare you agree to these terms.
terms.s1Body: AltCare is for alternative medicine practitioners and their clinic staff. New accounts are reviewed by our team before they are activated, and we may decline or suspend an account.
terms.s2Body: Keep your sign-in details private and do not share a login between people. You are responsible for activity under your account.
terms.s3Body: AltCare is a tool for keeping records and issuing documents. It does not replace your professional judgement. You are responsible for the accuracy of what you record and prescribe, and for complying with the rules that apply to your practice.
terms.s4Body: What is included depends on your plan. Plan contents and limits may change; we will give notice of material changes.
terms.s5Body: Do not misuse the service, attempt to access other clinics' data, or use AltCare for anything unlawful.
terms.s6Body: A paid plan is prepaid for a period and ends on the stated date. When a plan ends, your clinic moves to the Free plan's limits and keeps its data. Messaging credits are for communicating with your own patients; spam or misuse may lead to suspension. A price change applies to future periods only, never to a period you have already paid for. Refunds are governed by our Refund and cancellation policy.
terms.s6LinkText: Read the Refund and cancellation policy
terms.s7Body: AltCare is provided as is. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect loss arising from its use.

disclaimer.title: Medical Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: AltCare provides software for practitioners and general information. It is not medical advice.
disclaimer.s1Body: Nothing on this website is a diagnosis, treatment plan or substitute for advice from a qualified practitioner. Do not delay or avoid seeking care because of something you read here.
disclaimer.s2Body: In an emergency, contact local emergency services or go to the nearest hospital.
disclaimer.s3Body: Many traditional remedies have not been tested to the standard of conventional medicine. Information is shown for reference and does not promise any result.
disclaimer.s4Body: Mention of a practitioner, institution or product is not an endorsement. Check qualifications and registration before relying on anyone.
